question: Did anything change in cache efficiency and latency in August 2026? Compare before (2026-07-20 00:00 to 2026-08-10 11:00 UTC) with after (2026-08-11 to 2026-08-31): the overall cache-hit rate, P50/P95 TTFT of successful interactive chat/agents requests served outside US-East, and average GPU utilization outside US-East.
ground_truth_answer: Prefix cache v2 (kv-cache v2.0.0, 2026-08-10 11:00:00 UTC) raised the cache-hit rate from 24.6% to 51.1%. Interactive chat/agents TTFT outside US-East fell from P50 232 / P95 747 ms to P50 205 / P95 574 ms, and GPU utilization from 41.4% to 36.8%.

WITH q AS (
WITH s AS (SELECT CASE WHEN timestamp < '2026-08-10 11:00:00' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS g, ttft_ms AS v FROM usage_events WHERE endpoint IN ('chat','agents') AND workload_type='interactive' AND gpu_region <> 'US-East' AND ttft_ms IS NOT NULL AND ((timestamp >= '2026-07-20' AND timestamp < '2026-08-10 11:00:00') OR (timestamp >= '2026-08-11' AND timestamp < '2026-09-01'))),
r AS (SELECT g, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY v) - 1 AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g) AS n FROM s)
SELECT g, MAX(n) AS n, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CAST(n * 0.5 AS INT) THEN v END) AS p50, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CAST(n * 0.95 AS INT) THEN v END) AS p95 FROM r GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
)
SELECT x.n AS n_after, y.n AS n_before, x.p50 AS p50_after, y.p50 AS p50_before, x.p95 AS p95_after, y.p95 AS p95_before, ROUND(x.p50 / y.p50, 2) AS p50_ratio, ROUND(x.p95 / y.p95, 2) AS p95_ratio

question: Evaluate the business and operational impact of the August 2026 prefix-cache change: latency, GPU efficiency, customer sentiment and revenue.
